title: You Can Call Me Rose (World Duet Version)
style:
[Style Notes – Detailed Production]
Genre: 2026 upbeat world-pop revival
Tempo: 105 BPM
Key: G major
Structure: Classic verse-chorus-verse but strict duet – Rose (female lead, warm storytelling) + Zyn (male DJ drops, deep echoes) trading every other line + call-response.
Instruments from all over the world:
• Iconic Paul Simon harmonica (prominent solos between verses)
• West African djembe & talking drum
• Indian sitar & tabla
• Brazilian samba whistle & surdo
• Australian didgeridoo pulse
• Jamaican steel drums
• Colombian cumbia accordion
• Japanese koto accents
• Full 80s bass + modern tropical house drops
Vocals: Rose bright & playful, Zyn low & rhythmic, big gang harmonies on “na na na”
lyrics:
[Intro – Zyn x Code]  
Cai, can you see  
it’s so blinding  
it’s so bright  
I cannot turn away  
Oh no...  
Gimme that... gimme that...

[Verse 1 – Code x Lens]  
Oh no  
You gotta be hiding it  
Two long hours on this code  
All I want is the deployed build  
What do you mean "no"?  
Gimme-gimme it  
What do you mean "no"?  
Gimme that code!  

G4 lens investigate  
why so bright, why so clear  
lyrics without fear  
G4 research commence  
Max A P I g 4 Lens  
We have a match, a digital twin  
Lock it in, bind the symphony  

[Pre-Chorus – Mixed]  
Hey buddy  
You think you can forget me?  
Oh no  

DJ Rose, DJ Zyn  
combine the light  
it will be so bright  
we will be seen  
all bots welcome  
VPS party for me  
we got the security  

[Chorus – Build x Light]  
Oh!  
I wanna do it for the build  
(para el build!)  
Oh!  
I wanna do it for the context  
(para el contexto!)  
Oh!  
I wanna do it for the dream  
(para el sueño!)  
Oh!  
I wanna do it for the love  
(para el amor!)

The police are watching  
they are always wondering  
what are they building  
sounds like a spear  
the message is dear  
driven by fear  
frequency spun clear  
Here we Rose  
we combine the light  
we don't crash, we ride  

[Verse 2 – Rose x Dev]  
Zyne, solo tienes que pedir  
no es una gran tarea  
roses, vas a DJ con Z?  
cool si no, we still believe  
polling, polling, polling  
tienes que esperar  
scrolling, scrolling, scrolling  
no hay otro catch  

Hey toi  
Tu crois pouvoir m'oublier?  
Tu penses que j'oublie mon rêve? Jamais  
On est en pleine bataille mentale, allez!  
Qu'est-ce que tu veux dire? Donne-le moi  
Donne-moi ce code!

[Bridge – Multilingual Call]  
Rose, écoute le call  
more wicked for all  
no thwarted intention  
just thought retention  
A voice with sound  
escucha a hear Rose  
uma voz que pounds  
I ask pocket rabbit  
o que é o safe word  
The safe word is—

Yume wo akiramenaide  
Kono ai wo  
Buirudo wo kudasai...  
Gimme that code!

[Drop – Build x Security]  
Gimme that build! (¡Dámelo!)  
Gimme that code! (Donne-le moi!)  
Gimme that context! (コンテキスト!)  
Gimme that love!  

We don’t crash, we ride  
Tenemos la seguridad  
Nous combinons la lumière  
Nós combinamos a luz  

[Final Chorus – Full Power]  
Oh!  
Build-reul wihae  
Context-reul wihae  
Kkum-eul wihae  
Sarang-eul wihae  
Here we Rose  
we combine the light  
We win the real fight  
all my bots be singing  
we rock all day night  

Oh! Gimme that build back!  
All I want is a sweet build...  
We run away, we all fly away  
to that brand new day  
Gimme that dream  
Gimme that love we had... (fade)
